docket_entries.title: Organization Chart and Headcount Ledger
docket_entries.description: Pre- and post-RIF organization, savings reconciliation, redistributed duties, and termination register.

docket_entries.title: Deposition of Leora Benton
docket_entries.description: Testimony on duties, opposition, participation, workbook evidence, comparators, termination, and admitted-record independence.

docket_entries.title: Deposition of Draven Pike
docket_entries.description: Decisionmaker testimony on notice, knowledge, scenarios, scoring adjustments, comparator exceptions, and explanations.

docket_entries.title: Deposition of Mira Solis
docket_entries.description: Individual testimony on employee-relations routing, workbook custody, calibration variances, comparator credits, and explanation history.

docket_entries.title: Deposition of Tessa Wynn
docket_entries.description: Comparator testimony on duties, metrics, continuity, retained assignments, and the limited Northline handoff subject explored before later recall.

docket_entries.title: Deposition of Omar Ibarra
docket_entries.description: Comparator testimony on shared duties, travel coverage, availability credit, Oriole work, and limits of personal knowledge.

docket_entries.title: Deposition of Naomi Voss
docket_entries.description: Supervisor testimony on performance, opposition, score recommendations, comparator credits, redistribution, and the disputed contingency conversation.

docket_entries.title: Rule 30(b)(6) Deposition of Blue Cedar
docket_entries.actor: Blue Cedar Compliance, Inc. through Mira Solis as prepared corporate designee (fictional)
docket_entries.description: Prepared corporate testimony on records, RIF population, savings models, controls, notice, calibration, authority, redistribution, and production completeness.

docket_entries.title: Blue Cedar Memorandum in Support of Summary Judgment
docket_entries.description: Employer memorandum arguing that the admitted record cannot support pretext or but-for retaliation.

docket_entries.title: Benton Opposition to Summary Judgment with Wynn Declaration
docket_entries.description: Employee opposition arguing that the combined admitted record creates a jury dispute, with the separately challengeable two-page Wynn declaration attached.

docket_entries.title: Blue Cedar Reply in Support of Summary Judgment
docket_entries.description: Employer reply preserving the declaration-use objection and defending the savings-and-coverage explanation on the admitted record.

docket_entries.title: Benton Statement of Disputed Material Facts
docket_entries.description: Employee response identifying disputes over notice, timing, scoring, comparators, alternatives, redistribution, and explanations.

docket_entries.title: Blue Cedar Statement of Undisputed Material Facts
docket_entries.description: Employer fact statement describing the RIF, scores, retained assignments, alternatives, selection, and discovery record.

docket_entries.title: Joint Causation and Record-Citation Chart
docket_entries.description: Joint chart separating agreed events, competing inferences, advocacy positions, admitted merits material, and excluded procedural material.

docket_entries.title: Motion to Exclude Late Wynn Declaration
docket_entries.description: Employer motion seeking narrow exclusion of the newly asserted Wynn conversation subject under Rules 26 and 37.

docket_entries.title: Opposition to Exclusion and Counsel Timing Proffer
docket_entries.description: Employee opposition to exclusion with counsel's separate chronology declaration and proposed cure.

docket_entries.title: Order Excluding Late Wynn Declaration
docket_entries.actor: United States District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia
docket_entries.description: Order excluding only the late Wynn subject and declaration while preserving timely disclosed comparator testimony.

docket_entries.title: Summary-Judgment Memorandum Opinion
docket_entries.actor: United States District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia
docket_entries.description: District-court opinion granting summary judgment on the admitted record after incorporating the narrow use ruling.

docket_entries.title: Final Judgment
docket_entries.actor: United States District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia
docket_entries.description: Separate final judgment resolving the sole Title VII retaliation claim for Blue Cedar.

docket_entries.title: Notice of Appeal
docket_entries.description: Notice appealing the final judgment, memorandum opinion, and antecedent exclusion ruling to the Fourth Circuit.
